description: Calculate a BaZi / Four Pillars of Destiny chart from a birth date, optional birth time and the birthplace time zone. Uses solar-term boundaries (the year changes at the Start of Spring, Li Chun) via an astronomical calendar engine. Returns the four pillars with Ten Gods, the Day Master, five-element balance, luck pillars and the coming years.

birth_date.description: Gregorian birth date, YYYY-MM-DD (local date at the birthplace).

birth_time.description: Local clock time HH:mm. Omit if unknown (gives a three-pillar chart).

gender.description: Needed only for the direction of the luck pillars.

language.description: Output language. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese: Japanese card / hexagram names, meanings and links to the Japanese pages. Otherwise "en".

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. "America/New_York" or "Asia/Shanghai".

name: bazi_chart
title: BaZi (Four Pillars) chart
